review_method: Read installed help from disk and official NOAA output article; no ALOHA execution

findings.point_graph: Installed help describes ground-level indoor and outdoor averaged concentrations during the first hour after release starts.
findings.averaging: Toxic display described as a few minutes; flammable display as ten seconds. No single exact toxic averaging interval is established here.
findings.maximum: Official NOAA example distinguishes maximum outdoor and indoor concentrations in the Text Summary; these are not instantaneous peaks.
findings.coordinates: Relative downwind/crosswind points follow the wind direction; fixed east/north points identify geographic offsets.
findings.zone: Toxic zone indicates threshold exceedance at some time after release, not a simultaneous cloud snapshot.

project_policy: For this scalar suite capture reported outdoor maximum of averaged concentration over the first hour at the requested relative ground-level receptors. Diagnostic thresholds carry no health authority.
unresolved: actual observed output basis and evidence
exact toxic averaging interval by selected method
source thermodynamic applicability and remaining case mapping gates
